svg.title: How the selective agent library works
svg.text: How the selective agent library works
One router skill, a compact catalog, and only the profiles that help
its code and rules come first

g.text: You describe the task as usual. No agent names, no router prompt
The agent finds one router skill in the added AI-Agents folder
The router searches a compact catalog, not 269 full profiles
Quarantined profiles were left out when the catalog was built
It reads one primary specialist and at most two reviewers, nothing else
Profiles advise; your project's code and instructions still win
Publishing, deploying, deleting or spending still waits for your yes
